Lp(a)HORIZON's entry cut was 70 mg/dL against the 50 this is drawn at, and it enrolled established atherosclerotic disease, so the trial population is a subset of a subset. eligible_pct, penetration_peak_pct and the ramp are deliberately empty: the trial missed, Novartis has stated no filing intent, and the result for the pre-specified 90 mg/dL subpopulation is not public. WHAT THIS MEANS FOR TWO LIVE SEEDS: olpasiran (AMGN) and lepodisiran (LLY) both carry 0.06 penetration on the proposition that lowering lipoprotein(a) reduces events. That proposition has now been tested once in Phase 3 and failed. The 0.06 was already a stretch on its own anchor, since Leqvio's measured 2024 capture was 27,659 new starts against the 288,337 that 6% of the elevated-Lp(a) pool implies, 10.4x more starts and 52x the rate
